prompt: I want to create a ceremony pipeline that takes voice notes from my walks, transcribes them, decomposes the intention, and somehow routes the fragments to the right place in my ecology. The fragments could be reflections, tasks, issues, or seeds. I assume Whisper will handle transcription and probably qmd will help with routing but I am not sure how the classification works yet.

primary.target: ceremony pipeline that ingests voice notes, transcribes, decomposes intention, classifies fragments, and routes them into the user's ecology

secondary.target: classified fragments -> destination in ecology (issues, tasks, seeds, reflections)
qmd as routing mechanism / integration approach
taxonomy, mapping rules, and routing policy for fragment types
connectors to destinations (issue tracker, task manager, notes store)
transcription accuracy, decomposition quality, classification precision, routing correctness
pipeline design, operator instructions, privacy considerations

files_needed: pipeline.py or pipeline/ (ingest, transcribe, classify, route)
tools_required: qmd (or QMD-based routing system) - to evaluate
Task management API (e.g., Todoist/Asana) or local task store
assumptions: Whisper will be used/available for transcription (user assumption)
qmd may be useful for routing (user assumption)
Fragments map to four categories: reflections, tasks, issues, seeds (user-stated)
User's 'ecology' has programmatic endpoints for ingestion (implied but not specified)

artifacts: classifier and model artifacts under models/ or classifier.py
updates: possibly KINSHIP.md or relevant documentation describing how the pipeline fits the ecology
communications: Create design PR with pipeline implementation
Open issues for unresolved questions: classification criteria, destination APIs, privacy handling
Add docs/ design doc and usage guide in repo

End-to-end tests that verify fragments land in correct destinations and that metadata (timestamps, origin) are preserved

Build decomposition/classifier, integrate with pipeline, and implement routing connectors
Deploy automation (cron or event-driven) and add monitoring/logging
